verdict.rationale: Cursor's docs say Cloud Agents run in isolated VMs, that you "can run as many agents as you want in parallel", and that they need no connected local machine. They can be launched and managed at scale through the Cloud Agents API, the SDK's cloud runtime (built to survive caller disconnect), self-hosted worker pools, worktrees and parallel subagents; the homepage explicitly claims fleets working "for hours or days." Missing for 10: documented runtime limits or detail backing the multi-hour/multi-day duration beyond the marketing tagline, and any independent or hands-on corroboration of long-running parallel fleets.
